This course content is about 3D creation and space design software through theoretical and practical cases: 3DS MAX - the concept and application scope, and then the teacher introduces the methods of 3D environment construction into practical case practice operations, and finally creates students' own creation project. The purpose of the course is to train students to use the 3DS MAX software to construct 3D models, character modeling, space, and related objects, and use the result and performance to space display.

1.	Introduction and Description; 3D Animation Production Process and Scope
2.	Overview of the 3ds Max Interface; Basic Operation Techniques
3.	Modeling Method 1: Converting 2D Objects into 3D Models
4.	Modeling Method 2: 3D Objects and Poly Modeling
5.	Modeling Method 2: 3D Objects and Poly Modeling-2
6.	Material Texture 1: Concepts and Applications of Material Balls
7.	Material Texture 2: Texture Mapping Channels
8.	Material Texture 3: Advanced Material Balls
9.	Midterm Report: 3D Computer Graphics Modeling Works *Midterm Presentation
10.	Material Texture 4: Unwrapping Textures (Unwrap Map)-1
11.	Material Texture 4: Unwrapping Textures (Unwrap Map)-2
12.	Lighting Setup 1: Types of Lights and Setup; Three-Point Lighting
13.	Lighting Setup 2: Optical Lighting & Application of IES Files
14.	Lighting Setup 3: Render Applications
15.	Camera Animation and Cinematography-1
16.	Camera Animation and Cinematography-2
17.	Final Project Discussion and Production
18.	Final Report: Static Computer Graphics Artwork *Final Presentation
